synopsis: Hannah Spencer is the Green Party MP for Gorton and Denton, and has been an MP continually since 26 February 2026. She currently undertakes the roles of Green Spokesperson (Housing, Communities and Local Government), Green Spokesperson (Education), Green Spokesperson (Culture, Media and Sport), and Green Spokesperson (Business, Innovation, Science and Trade).
